points.point: Is the missing post in the picker a bug?
points.sentence: The post picker lists posts published through Blotato only.

points.point: Post made in Meta Business Suite
points.sentence: A post you published directly in the Instagram or Facebook app, in Meta Business Suite, or through another tool never appears in the picker.

verdict.reason: The entry states the picker lists only Blotato-published posts and that posts made in Meta Business Suite never appear, so it isn't a bug.
